prompt.project_info: Create a modern luxury lifestyle portrait of an approved adult platinum-blonde woman reclining on a cream curved sofa.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long platinum-white blonde wavy hair, light blue-green eyes, fair natural skin, nude-pink lips, minimal makeup, and a thoughtful relaxed expression. She wears a red fitted one-piece fashion outfit with thin straps and reclines on her side, propped on one elbow, with one hand under her chin and the other on the sofa cushion, looking at camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 medium/full lifestyle portrait, subject reclining diagonally on a cream curved sofa, dark olive curtains and a large wooden-framed window to the side, white walls and contemporary apartment details behind. Keep hair, red outfit, sofa, and window light as hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural daylight from the window, gentle shadows, bright modern interior, elegant relaxed calm mood, natural neutral grading with rich red outfit.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end smartphone or professional camera, eye-level front-facing perspective, medium framing with sofa visible, realistic skin and fabric, natural depth of field, subtle grain, 3:4 crop.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic modern luxury lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman with long platinum-white blonde wavy hair, light blue-green eyes, fair natural skin, nude-pink lips, minimal makeup, and a soft thoughtful relaxed expression. She wears a red fitted one-piece fashion outfit with thin straps and reclines on her side on a cream curved contemporary sofa, propped on one elbow, one hand under her chin and the other resting on the cushion, looking directly at the camera. Include dark olive green floor-length curtains, a large wooden-framed window, white walls, and a sophisticated minimalist apartment. Use soft diffused natural daylight, gentle shadows, realistic skin and fabric, eye-level lifestyle perspective, natural depth, warm neutral tones with rich red, and a vertical 3:4 composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
